theme: An open Saturday before a full Sunday
greeting: Nothing is on today's calendar, Dan — the day is yours. The pull is tomorrow: the 9 AM board review with Mike and the 5 PM island annual meeting, plus two travel bookings whose windows have quietly closed.

needsAttention.title: Sunday board review with Mike
needsAttention.detail: The 15-minute review is at 9 AM — arrive ready to empty the Inbox and put a decision on the items that have slipped three Sundays running.

needsAttention.title: DIRA & DIBA annual meeting
needsAttention.detail: The island Bridge and Road associations meet by Zoom at 5 PM; materials come separately by email, so check for them and skim before you join.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The p1 task to book a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has sat since mid-September. Holiday inventory at PWM sells out — this is the one most likely to bite.

needsAttention.title: December break destination
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by Sept 30 and book-by Oct 15 have both passed; six people, Dec 13–Jan 2, over the holidays — the thinnest inventory of the year is only getting thinner.

flagged.title: Venmo request, $50
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver requested $50 for mowing (10-14) — a real pending request sitting in the inbox.

flagged.title: LinkedIn invite from IFAC
flagged.detail: A director at IFAC sent a connection request — worth a response given your governance network.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos — St. Pete local, Monocle, Trip.com, and the Italian and sailing digests.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on a reply from you.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: Autumn cooking leans on what the season gives: roots, squash, and long, slow heat.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder
Drive the Pathfinder down to St Pete

acts.line: An open Saturday in St. Pete — nothing on the books beyond the cottage on Coffee Pot Bayou.
Still clear; the two slipped travel bookings are the one thing that would reward an hour.
Quiet tonight, with tomorrow's 9 AM board review and the 5 PM island annual meeting ahead.
